messages:
Samira V. (People Ops): Heads-up thread for Lina Zhou's SF onsite Thu Jun 10. She flies in from Shanghai, lands SFO 06:05 PT. Needs: later start (~11:00), visa-expense guidance (CNY receipts), hotel prepay option, standing desk, vegetarian meal, visitor badge, and Meet fallback if customs slow.
Noel P. (Recruiter): Lina asked if we can prepay the hotel night since she needs a visa letter. She prefers 11:00-14:00 PT. I'll confirm license plate for parking.
Eve L. (Office Admin): I can reserve Conf North + Quiet Room and a standing desk. I can also hold a prepaid hotel booking if People Ops approves. Need full name as on passport for badge.
Jon M. (Hiring Manager): 11:00-14:00 works. Panel will be 90m technical + 30m culture. We'll join 10m early.
Samira V. (People Ops): Reimbursement rules quick: originals preferred, photos accepted. For CNY receipts include conversion note: "amount in CNY converted to USD using xe.com on date of expense". Hotel prepay ok for visa letter cases  finance will invoice invoice@redwood.example. Taxi cap SFO->office $95. Submit scans to travel@redwood.example within 30 days.
Noel P. (Recruiter): I'll ask Lina for passport name and whether she needs hotel prepay. Also told her about taxi cap and receipts process.
calendar-bot: Calendar event created: "Onsite  Lina Zhou" Thu Jun 10 11:00-14:00 PT  https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=lina123 (rooms: Conf North + Quiet Room, Meet fallback: https://meet.google.com/lina-fallback).
Eve L. (Office Admin): Badge prep in progress under "Lina Zhou". Standing desk and spare charger in Quiet Room. If Noel confirms hotel prepay I'll attach booking to the event. Vegetarian lunch ordered for 12:30.
Noel P. (Recruiter): Lina confirmed she needs the visa letter and requests hotel prepay. I'll send passport name and plate tonight. Sending candidate itinerary + Meet fallback 24h prior and CC travel@redwood.example.
Samira V. (People Ops): Sample expense snippet for candidate email:
```
Item: Taxi SFO->Office
Amount: 120 CNY
Convert: 120 CNY = $16.40 USD (xe.com on 2026-06-09)
Attach: photo of original receipt
Submit: travel@redwood.example within 30 days
```
Jon M. (Hiring Manager): I'll bring an HDMI dongle and join early. Thanks all.
Samira V. (People Ops): Marking this as the canonical day-of thread. Ping here for any last-minute changes. :spiral_calendar:
